recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray #F5F5F5 and use a 16:9 canvas.
2. Add a yellow circle #FFFF00 at the top-right with black bold text 42.
3. Top-left: draw a 6-column table/matrix with header x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6; rows (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), (1)(2)(1)(4)(5)(6), (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6); bottom class row C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2. Make C1 red #FF0000 and C2 blue #0000FF; use white cells with thin black borders.
4. Top-center: add text Initial W = with a 2x1 matrix [4; -2], then red italic text Step η = 2.
5. Top-right: add caption Check classes of and a matrix headed Z1 Z1 Z1 with rows (0)(7)(3) and (0)(6)(2). Below it add the legend C1 positive, C2 negative, Zero is unaccepted, coloring C1 red, C2 blue, and Zero green.
6. Left-middle: add caption Upgraded Vectors (From Top) and a second 6-column table with header x1–x6; rows (1)(1)(1)(1)(1)(1), (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6); class row C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2 with the same colors.
7. Add a red rectangle #FF0000 below the left table with white bold text Iteration 1.
8. On the right, create five evenly spaced equation rows. Use black text for d(x_i), matrices, and Keep same Weight; use red #FF0000 for Update Weight. Place a black ⇒ between each d(x_i) result and the action. Add a green #008000 ⇐ at the far right of rows 1 and 4 only.
9. Enter the exact formulas: row 1 d(x1)=[1 1 1 4; -2 0]=0, W=[4;-2]+2*[1;1]=[6;0]; row 2 d(x2)=[1 2 1 6; 0 0]=6, W=[6;0]; row 3 d(x3)=[1 1 2; 0 0]=6, W=[6;0]; row 4 d(x4)=[1 5 4; 0 0]=6, W=[6;0]-2*[1;5]=[4;-10]; row 5 d(x5)=[1 6 5; -10 -98]=-96, W=[4;-10].
10. Keep all math left-aligned within each row and align the W result matrices in a consistent vertical column.
